title: Evaluate Precision of the Test for Lactate in Capillary Whole Blood Specimens Using the i-STAT CG4+ Cartridge With the i-STAT 1 Analyzer
official: Clinical Evaluation of Precision of the Lactate Test for Capillary Whole Blood Specimens Using the i-STAT CG4+ Cartridge With the i-STAT 1 Analyzer
summary: Assess precision of the i-STAT lactate test with the i-STAT CG4+ cartridge on the i-STAT 1 analyzer using two (2) separate capillary blood specimens.
